tvShow.name: Chained Soldier
tvShow.overview: Destructive monsters from the Mato dimension threaten the earth, while women gifted with powers from Peaches try to stop them. But to save the world, Yuuki must be willing to become Chief Kyoka's servant both on the battlefield and at home.

episodes.name: Birth, Yuuki, Awakening
episodes.overview: Yuuki Wakura wanders through a gate to an alternate dimension. He meets the Demon Defense Force including Chief Kyouka Uzen, who will reward him for his servitude.

episodes.name: Curiosity, Shushu, Undress
episodes.overview: Yuuki is recruited to work as a caretaker at the 7th Squadron’s dorm in Mato. Shushu catches him unaware and turns him into her boy toy. Suddenly, a giant Shuuki attacks!

episodes.name: Encounter, Kyouka,  Rampage
episodes.overview: With dozens of Shuuki detected, and a score to settle, Yuuki and the Demon Defense Force Squadron take an interdimensional trip!

episodes.name: Whirlwind, Himari, Roar
episodes.overview: The Demon Defense Force decides to take measures against the humanoid Shuuki. Meanwhile, Himari can adopt someone else’s ability, which she does to turn Yuuki “loyal” to her.

episodes.name: Sisters, Yachiho, Ridicule
episodes.overview: Yuuki hits Yachiho with a “Brand Break,” so she rewinds to before the beginning of the match. Later, Himari appreciates Yuuki; it’s time for his reward to begin!

episodes.name: Blitz, Sahara, Twinkle
episodes.overview: Up next in Round 2: It's Shushu Suruga of the 7th Squadron versus Sahara Wakasa of the 6th Squadron! And after the match, Shushu has a surprise for Yuuki.

episodes.name: United Front, Tenka, Soar
episodes.overview: Tenka confronts Rairen, then uses her ability to manipulate space. Later, Yuuuki tidies up and gets a face full of more than dirty laundry!

episodes.name: Promise, Nei, Remember
episodes.overview: Tenka wants Yuuki as her new pet, but Kyouka declines her request. Nei explains her clairvoyant powers, the “promise.”

episodes.name: Reunion, Coco, Lick
episodes.overview: A demon who looks like Yuuki’s sister appears and abducts him! Then after the dust settles, an enemy licks Yuuki down for... medical reasons.

episodes.name: War, Naon, Recite
episodes.overview: Yuuki learns a less than peachy truth. Later, he receives a finger licking good reward.

episodes.name: Death Match, Aoba, Excite
episodes.overview: With Yuuki tied up and unable to fight, it’s up to the girls to harness the power of the peaches in a non-stop battle. Suddenly, those who control the demons appear...

episodes.name: Homecoming, New, Resolve
episodes.overview: Yuuki finds a new reason to fight: to return Aoba to her original human form.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Yuuki Wakura watches as dueling supernatural forces ravage the Earth. Mato are portals to another dimension, avenues from which dangerous monsters escape. Peaches are resources given to women granting them abilities. Chief of the Seventh Unity of the Anti-Demon Corp, Kyouka Uzen arrives to save Yuuki from a monster. Surprisingly, Yuuki holds the power to increase the Peaches effectiveness. But to save the world, Yuuki must be willing to become Kyouka’s servant both on the battlefield and at home.

episodes.name: Commanders' Meeting
episodes.overview: The 7th Squad may have settled into a new normal, but trouble soon follows when the commanders hold a meeting.

episodes.name: Ren's Shadow
episodes.overview: Ren grows increasingly interested in Yukki, especially once one of the Eight Thunder Gods appears in his room.

episodes.name: A Storm Rolls In
episodes.overview: Yakumo wants nothing more than a harem full of women. But when she sets her sights on Yuuki, she just might decide to add him, too.

episodes.name: Rampage
episodes.overview: When Ren orders Kyouka to lend her Yuuki, the Supreme Commander unlocks a form befitting her power. However, even her might isn't enough to deny Yuuki a reward.

episodes.name: The Azuma Banquet
episodes.overview: A contest will decide the next head of the Azuma Family.

episodes.name: A New Azuma
episodes.overview: Fubuki challenges Himari to a duel.

episodes.name: Late Summer Slave
episodes.overview: Kyouka notices how many women are growing closer to Yuuki.

episodes.name: The Commander of the 2nd Squadron
episodes.overview: When a Thunder God begins abducting women, the Demon Defense Force sends Mira and Kyouka to confront her.

episodes.name: A Commander's Resolve
episodes.overview: Mira is a formidable fighter, but her opponent is a Thunder God. If she wants to win, she'll have to pull out all the stops.

episodes.name: Yokohama Showdown
episodes.overview: Kuusetsu's new power makes her more dangerous than ever.

episodes.name: Slave: Heaven
episodes.overview: Yuuki and Kyouka have come a long way, and they've forged a bond strong enough to stand against a god. But even if they win this battle, the war is far from over.

episodes.name: Gods Assemble
episodes.overview: In the aftermath, both the Demon Defense Force and the Thunder Gods prepare for what comes next.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The fight against the Shuuki continues as Chained Soldier returns with more monsters, supernatural action, and spicy 'rewards'! In a world where only women can wield the power of supernatural "Peaches," which grant unusual powers to those who eat them, Yuuki (despite his gender) joins the Demon Defense Squad to combat evil demons called Shuuki from destroying human civilization.
